instructions: which logical fallacy, if any, does this statement commit?

taxonomy.ad_hominem: attacking the opponent instead of their argument
taxonomy.ad_populum: appealing to popularity instead of the merits
taxonomy.appeal_to_emotion: manipulating emotion instead of engaging with the argument
taxonomy.circular_reasoning: assuming the conclusion in the premises
taxonomy.equivocation: using a word in two different senses
taxonomy.fallacy_of_credibility: leaning on the source's credibility instead of evidence
taxonomy.fallacy_of_extension: stretching the opponent's claim beyond what it says
taxonomy.fallacy_of_logic: the reasoning structure itself is invalid
taxonomy.fallacy_of_relevance: diverting to an issue that is irrelevant
taxonomy.false_dilemma: presenting only two options when others exist
taxonomy.intentional: rejecting the argument because of the opponent's intent
